name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine according to package directions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Cook chicken in olive oil over medium-high heat, 6-7 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
In the same pan, melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream. Bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in parmesan until melted and smooth. Add pasta water if sauce is too thick.
Toss pasta in sauce, top with sliced chicken and fresh parsley.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free butter, coconut cream, and nutritional yeast instead of parmesan.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve over zucchini noodles or spaghetti squash.
